messages:
Lina - People Ops: Quick share — condensed manager handoff + self-review script for the next performance cycle. Use in 1:1s or drop into your team channel. Keep it short and copy/pasteable.

Lina - People Ops: TL;DR: 3x goals (SMART), 3x achievements, 1x growth area, 1x blockers, and 1 impact metric per goal.

Lina - People Ops: Manager script (pasteable):
```
1) Goal checklist (for the manager):
- Confirm goal owner and measurable metric (how we know it's done).
- Agree on success criteria and tracking cadence (weekly/biweekly).
- Note dependencies and escalation path.

2) Self-review prompt (send to individual):
- Please list your top 3 accomplishments this cycle (2-4 bullets each).
- For each active goal, add one metric or signal of impact.
- One growth area you want coaching on and one concrete step you will take.
- Any blockers or resource asks.

Suggested formats: bullets, 120-200 words per goal summary.
```

Omar - Eng Manager: Love this — can we add a single-line 'impact metric' example per goal? e.g., "reduce p95 latency by 20%".

Lina - People Ops: Yes — added in the snippet (impact metric per goal). Feel free to swap examples for your team.

Sydney - PM: Super helpful. Small ask: include a one-sentence guidance for calibration chats (how managers should summarize across direct reports).

Lina - People Ops: Good call. Add this: "Calibration note: summarize top 3 signals (impact, reliability, craft) in one sentence per report."

Rachael - People Ops: FYI I'll drop a one-pager in the Goals & Reviews doc and pin it to the People Ops channel. Also recommend managers ping teams 7 days before self-review deadline.

hr-bot: Reminder: self-review window opens 2026-04-01 and closes 2026-04-14. (Auto-posted)

Omar - Eng Manager: @Lina @Rachael perfect — I'll run this in my 1:1s this week. :thumbsup:

Lina - People Ops: Thanks all — if you want a tailored manager script for ICs vs. Leads I can make a short variant. Reply here and I'll send it. :sparkles:
